sections.name: Tricky (Dino Domain's boss race)
sections.card:
Summary: The first world's boss, a triceratops you race in a car up a spiralling mountain in Dino Domain.
Weak points: Red and blue Weapon Balloons are placed on his course to help you against him. Stay out of his path, because bumping into him squashes you and slows you down, and in the rematch he is faster, so you have to use the balloons to win.
Looks like: A large red triceratops with yellow stripes on his back and yellow eyes with red irises.
Tips: He just keeps charging forward. Boulders now and then come down the mountain, and the second race adds more boulders plus pillars that fall.
Tips: You can only race him once you have won every other course in the world. After you beat him he sets you the world's Silver Coin challenges, and his piece of the Wizpig amulet only comes after the harder rematch.

sections.name: Bluey (Snowflake Mountain's boss race)
sections.card:
Summary: Snowflake Mountain's boss, a walrus you race in a hovercraft down an icy ski slope.
Looks like: A large blue walrus with a tuxedo piece at his neck, which the Nintendo DS remake leaves off.
Tips: The slope is jagged and lined with trees that get in your way. Like Tricky he only charges ahead, but unlike Tricky he does not squash you.
Tips: The rematch only comes after you finish Snowflake Mountain's Silver Coin challenges. In it Bluey is faster, and a few snowballs are added as extra obstacles.

sections.name: Bubbler (Sherbet Island's boss race)
sections.card:
Summary: Sherbet Island's boss, an octopus you race in a hovercraft for three laps around a small island.
Weak points: You can shoot him. Red Weapon Balloons give you missiles to fire at him during the race.
Looks like: A large red octopus with yellow eyes, green irises and black pupils.
Tips: In the first race he scatters mines in the water around him, and hitting one trips you up.
Tips: In the rematch he is faster and swaps the mines for giant bubbles that can trap you for a while.

sections.name: Smokey (Dragon Forest's boss race)
sections.card:
Summary: Dragon Forest's boss, a dragon you race in a plane for three laps through caves and fields.
Looks like: A dragon with an orange body, a yellow belly, face and feet, and green eyes, which makes him the only boss without yellow eyes.
Tips: He spits clouds of hot ash and drops puffs of fire behind him, and the fire can slow you down. In the rematch he flies faster and drops more of it.
Tips: Smokey Castle, the challenge level with his name, is not where you meet him, because he does not appear there.

sections.name: Taj's three vehicle races (Car, Hovercraft, Plane)
sections.card:
Summary: Once you have enough Golden Balloons in Adventure Mode, Taj turns up and challenges you to race him on his flying carpet, each time in a set vehicle, and beating him earns another Golden Balloon.
Weak points: Taj moves slowly in the Car Challenge, which makes it the easy one. The Hovercraft Challenge is somewhat harder, and the Plane Challenge is considered the hardest of the three.
Looks like: A blue elephant who is also a genie and rides a magic red carpet.
Tips: Red flags showing the Nintendo 64 logo mark the route, and you have to follow them. Leaving the track by too far a margin gets you disqualified.
Tips: Once a race is unlocked you can run it again whenever you like, but each one gives only a single Golden Balloon.

sections.name: T.T.'s ghosts (Time Trial)
sections.card:
Summary: In Tracks mode, Time Trial has you race T.T.'s best times. It is optional for the adventure, but beating him on every course is what makes T.T. playable.
Looks like: T.T. himself is an animated stopwatch with a red outer shell, a yellow inner case and a blue button on his head, plus black arms and legs with white gloves and shoes.
Tips: Each course has two times, an unlock time that brings out T.T.'s ghost and then a lower ghost time to beat. Dino Domain's four are Ancient Lake 1:07.00 then 1:01.28, Fossil Canyon 1:37.00 then 1:30.16, Jungle Falls 1:08.00 then 1:02.50 and Hot Top Volcano 1:35.00 then 1:30.71.

sections.name: Silver Coins (the Silver Coin Challenge)
sections.card:
Summary: Eight coins to find on each course. Collect all eight and win the race to earn a Golden Balloon.
Uses: Taj hands over the Golden Balloon when you finish a challenge. A world's challenges only open after you have beaten its boss once, and each course has its own minimum number of Golden Balloons before you can play its challenge.
Looks like: In the original game each coin has a colourful N64 icon on its sides.
Tips: Many of the coins are well hidden or sit off the track.
Tips: Clearing the Silver Coin Challenge on all four courses of a world sets up the rematch with that world's boss. In Adventure Two the coins are in different places, often hard to reach.
